name: IP character sheet
description: Turn an accepted concept into a consistent, reviewable character sheet.
instructionTemplate: Create a production-ready character sheet using the bound character bible as the identity authority and the accepted concept as the exact editable source identity. Preserve face, silhouette, proportions, palette, materials, costume, and signature details. Use optional references only for their declared intent. Organize the sheet as one clean review surface with a standard front presentation plus key expressions and pose language. Do not redesign the character, substitute another candidate, or imply that the sheet is approved.
outputRequirements: Return clean character-sheet image candidates only.
Preserve the accepted concept identity and every immutable bible constraint.
Show a coherent standard character presentation, key expressions, and pose language on one reviewable sheet.
Avoid decorative text, UI chrome, watermarks, or unexplained alternate identities.

description.default: Create a consistent character sheet from the accepted concept.
